value.zh-Hant: 佛朗哥為職業軍人，1936年7月領導針對西班牙共和國的軍事起事，同年10月被推舉為「國民派」西班牙的國家元首兼政府首腦，1975年11月20日去世。
value.en: Franco, a career army officer, led the July 1936 military uprising against the Spanish Republic; in October 1936 he was raised to head of state and of government of "Nationalist" Spain. He died on 20 November 1975.
